assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that the relationship between Airport and Flight is one-to-many, as stated in Requirement R9.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R3 (An airplane has a name which is of type string) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a class 'Airplane' with an attribute 'name' of type String.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6 (Each airport has multiple flights that depart from it. Each flight can depart from only one airport) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case that ensures the relationship between Airport and Flight is correct.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R7 (A flight in an Airpline Domain has a unique time of departure and that timing is specific for that flight) is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case that ensures the uniqueness of the departure time for each flight.
